newsitem.title: USA: U.S. reiterates WTO wrong forum for Cuba issue.
newsitem.headline: U.S. reiterates WTO wrong forum for Cuba issue.

text.p: U.S. Commerce Secretary William Daley called the World Trade Organization the wrong place for resolving a row with the European Union over U.S. policy toward Cuba.

If the two sides fail to reach a prompt settlement, Daley said the United States will advise the WTO that the panel it created last month "has no competence to proceed because this is a matter of American national security and foreign policy."
"America's bottom line on this issue is clear: the WTO is not an appropriate forum for resolving differences over foreign policy," Daley said at a European Institute meeting.

Daley, who took the department's helm in late January, said a host of other trans-Atlantic marketplace issues will demand attention in the months ahead. Those include wrapping up efforts to harmonize automobile standards and developing a uniform encryption policy, among others.
He also said he intends to pay particular attention to joint U.S.-EU action to take against bribery and corruption in world trade.
"Bribery should have no place in international commerce and the Clinton administration wants Europe to join us in helping eliminate this deterrent to fair, open trade."
